blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 26088429, the thUSD UUPS proxy still resolved to verified ThUSD implementation 0xcd04f57464d25f257089a286aab47df096d300ad, with owner 0x2bb4b7e6e83fa6b77d0143dad631843cb73dca02 and getMinDelay() = 172800 seconds. Current ERC-20 transfers have no pause, blacklist, allowlist, seizure, or transfer hook; TheoWhitelist gates mint and redeem only. Owner-only _authorizeUpgrade can replace this logic after the timelock, so freeze exposure remains possible. The Stable OFT at block 41274206 and Arbitrum OFT at block 510263215 are direct non-proxy ThUSDOFT deployments with ordinary ERC-20 transfers and no local pause, blacklist, seizure, arbitrary-holder burn, or upgrade function. Stable runtime matches the exact-match Sourcify Arbitrum implementation outside compiler-declared immutable slots (the chain-local endpoint differs). Bridge peer and EndpointV2 configuration authority affects cross-chain delivery and issuance, not local holder transfers.

oracleRisk.summary: Theo's backend determines mint and redemption amounts off-chain; the depositor signs the EIP-712 order and the MINTER_ROLE EOA submits it. Verified ThUSDMinter reads no Chainlink or other price feed and enforces one-sided nominal amount bounds, not exact 1:1 pricing: normalized thUSD <= collateral on mint, collateral <= thUSD on redeem. This is a top-level internal quote authority with user consent, separate from sthUSD's ERC-4626 share price.

branchApplicability.rationale: Verified ThUSDMinter._validateOrder normalizes decimals then checks `if (thusdAmountNormalized > collateralAmountNormalized) revert InvalidAssetRatio();` for MINT and `if (collateralAmountNormalized > thusdAmountNormalized) revert InvalidAssetRatio();` for REDEEM. There is no equality check or symmetric tolerance band: either gross output/input ratio may be below 1, subject to both raw amounts being at least 1e6 and the thUSD per-block cap. Theo documents backend-determined exchange rates; the depositor signs the chosen amounts, ECDSA.recover must equal order.signer, and only MINTER_ROLE can submit. Internal pricing therefore affects the top-level mint/redemption quote without CDP liquidation branches. setRedeemFeeBps is DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE-only and caps the separately applied fee at 10 bps; at Ethereum block 26088429 the fee was 5 bps and the two-day timelock held that role. No production external-feed validation or off-chain quote policy is disclosed in the reviewed sources.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum-native thUSD reaches Stable and Arbitrum through direct LayerZero v2 OFTs. At Ethereum block 26088429 the adapter escrow was 50,106,767.997097 thUSD; independently observed Stable block 41274206 supply was 49,916,245.784914 and Arbitrum block 510263215 supply was 190,522.212183. All six directed lanes among these chains have the configured shared-address peer and 3 required plus 1-of-2 optional DVNs. Send confirmations are Ethereum 15, Arbitrum 20, Stable 5; receive confirmations match the source chain. Owners are timelocks (Ethereum 172800 seconds, remote chains 64800), but EndpointV2 delegates are chain-local operator Safes that can change DVN and library configuration without those timelocks. BSC block 124858674 and Mantle block 101309261 supply was zero.
